source_evidence: Employers such as public educational institutions (public schools, colleges, and universities), certain non-profits, and churches or church-related organizations may offer 403(b) plans. Employers such as state and local government agencies and certain non-profit organizations may offer 457(b) plans.
question: Misconception: Only public schools and churches can offer 403(b) plans, while only government agencies can offer 457(b) plans.
answer: That is too narrow. The source says certain non-profit organizations may offer either type of plan, alongside the other listed employer categories. Eligibility depends on the employer; some employers offer both plans.
